items.title: Mayur More & Ashlesha Thakur To Lead AI Hybrid Movie 'Beta Builder'
items.headline: Mayur More & Ashlesha Thakur To Lead AI Hybrid Movie 'Beta Builder'
items.excerpt: Abundantia Entertainment's AI unit AiOn and video-tech firm InVideo are making 'Beta Builder', a hybrid feature that pairs live actors with AI-generated production.
items.rationale: Concrete new production: a cast, greenlit hybrid feature pairing live actors with AI-generated production (AiOn + InVideo).

items.title: Apple Creator Studio update: MotionVFX and AI
items.headline: Apple Creator Studio update: MotionVFX and AI
items.excerpt: Apple Creator Studio's free November update builds MotionVFX into Final Cut Pro and adds AI assistants across its creative apps.
items.rationale: Most actionable item in the pool: a free tool update that puts MotionVFX and AI assistants straight into editors' Final Cut Pro workflow.

items.title: AI Can Critique Shakespeare but Can't Write It, Russo Brothers' AGBO Execs Tell Tokyo Market
items.headline: AI Can Critique Shakespeare but Can't Write It, Russo Brothers' AGBO Execs Tell Tokyo Market
items.excerpt: At a TIFFCOM keynote, AGBO's technology heads argued AI should support artists and can't match the human element of storytelling.
items.rationale: Major-studio tech leads (AGBO) setting out where AI fits in their pipeline at TIFFCOM; new event, not covered before.

items.title: 2026 AI Horror Film Competition Winners!
items.headline: 2026 AI Horror Film Competition Winners!
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge wraps its 4th annual AI Horror Film Competition, announcing the winning AI-made horror films.
items.rationale: Whitelisted channel; the winning AI-made shorts show where AI filmmaking craft stands right now.

items.title: 한예종 AI 애니 '티켓 투 네버랜드'…일본 영화제 최종 경쟁 진출
items.headline: 한예종 AI 애니 '티켓 투 네버랜드'…일본 영화제 최종 경쟁 진출
items.excerpt: 한국예술종합학교 AT랩이 제작한 3D AI 애니메이션 '티켓 투 네버랜드'가 60여개국 730여편이 출품된 일본 국제 AI 영화제 경쟁 부문 파이널리스트 21편에 올랐다.
items.rationale: Korean angle: a K-Arts 3D AI animation made the final 21 of 730+ entries at an international AI film festival.
